@coderabbitai Re the outside-diff follow-up on `webcamPresetCenter` (webcam-layout.ts 185-196): fixed in c11f99d5. Presets now size the bubble with the same caps as `webcamRect`. With today's export frames the rectangle never hits the cap, but a 0.6 circle on a 9:16 export does. That gap predates this PR, and the fix covers it too. There is a test for that case.
